============================================================================
OmniBuf-Py Benchmark Suite (Python 3.14.5 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: 11-field PeerUpdate (366B OmniBuf, 341B Protobuf) + >16 KiB stress cases
Methodology: Full decode reads all 11 fields; mutations check city and increment/grow.
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 411 ns | 2,434,328 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (@dataclass) | 418 ns | 2,393,272 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| protobuf-py | 931 ns | 1,073,726 | 341 | 2.27x slower |
| google.protobuf (upb) | 432 ns | 2,316,944 | 341 | 1.05x slower |
| msgspec | 625 ns | 1,598,872 | 634 | 1.52x slower |
| msgpack | 1,699 ns | 588,747 | 634 | 4.13x slower |
| json (stdlib) | 4,859 ns | 205,825 | 874 | 11.83x slower |
